$comment: Programmes of study and the courses they add to the catalogue. Read by scripts/build-courses.mjs, which merges newCourses into data/courses.json and writes the programmes list there. Each programme has bachelor, master and phd levels, each with core courses in suggested order, an elective pool and milestones; a course can belong to several programmes and levels. A course's level says which tier it is written for. year and semester only order courses and are never shown as groupings.
